D: A mother and daughter swap bodies after a fortune cookie curse, the day before the mum's wedding.
P: Serve dessert when the fortune cookies arrive at the Chinese restaurant.
S: Fried rolls of pork mince, wombok, carrot and rice vermicelli
Pork, cabbage, carrot and vermicelli rolled in pastry, fried at 180C until crisp, with sweet chilli sauce.
Bite size chicken thigh coated in panko and paprika, shallow fried
Bite-size chicken thigh in crunchy paprika panko crumbs, shallow fried golden and served with honey mustard for dipping.
Rehearsal dinner salmon blinis and melon

Blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and chives, beside wedges of rockmelon wrapped in thin prosciutto, on silver trays. Warm 24 cocktail blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of half a lemon and a pinch of salt. Top each blini with a spoon of crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon from 150g and a few snipped chives. Cut half a rockmelon into 12 thin wedges, remove the skin and wrap each in a slice of prosciutto from 100g. Arrange both on a silver tray with lemon wedges.
M: Crispy chicken thigh tossed in a honey and soy glaze, with sesame
Chicken thigh pieces battered and fried crisp, tossed in a honey and soy glaze, with sesame and steamed rice.
the chaos the night before the wedding

Chicken strips seared, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes added with cream, spinach wilted through, tossed with penne and parmesan. Cook 400g penne in salted water until al dente. Slice 600g chicken breast into strips, season and sear in olive oil until golden, then set aside. In the same pan fry 3 sliced garlic cloves and 80g chopped sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute, pour in 300ml cream and simmer 3 minutes. Add 2 big handfuls baby spinach and stir until wilted. Toss through the chicken, pasta and 50g grated parmesan, loosening with pasta water. Serve with extra parmesan and black pepper.
W: Thin vanilla cookies folded into the classic fortune shape
Thin batter of egg white, sugar, flour and vanilla baked at 180C in small rounds for 6 minutes, folded around paper fortunes while hot.
K: Lychee jasmine iced tea with lime
Jasmine tea chilled with lychees, lychee syrup and lime

Jasmine tea brewed, chilled and shaken with lychee syrup and lime, poured over ice with whole lychees and topped with a splash of soda. Steep 4 jasmine tea bags in 800ml hot water at about 85C for 4 minutes, remove the bags and chill. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup. Mix the cold tea with 120ml lychee syrup and the juice of 1 lime. Fill 4 glasses with ice and 3 lychees each, pour over the tea and top with a splash of soda water and a lime wheel.

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli until soft, drain and chop.
Shred the wombok and grate the carrots.
Cook the pork mince until browned.
Mix the pork with the vermicelli and vegetables and cool.
Roll tightly in the spring roll pastry.
Fry at 180C in batches until crisp and blistered.
Serve hot with sweet chilli sauce.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces.
Mix the flour, panko, paprika and salt. Dip the chicken in egg, then in the crumb mix.
Shallow fry in batches until golden.
Drain and serve with honey mustard.
Cut the chicken and toss in cornflour.
Cook the jasmine rice.
Fry the chicken in batches until crisp.
Warm the honey with the soy sauce until bubbling and toss the chicken through.
Scatter with sesame seeds and serve over the rice.
Whisk the egg whites with the sugar, then mix in the flour, butter and vanilla.
Spread thin rounds on a lined tray.
Bake until the edges are golden, in batches.
Working quickly while hot, lay a fortune on each, fold and bend over a cup.
Cool until crisp.

Chill the tea.
Drain the lychees, keeping the syrup.
Mix the cold tea with some of the lychee syrup and the juice of a lime.
Fill glasses with ice and lychees, pour over the tea and top with soda water and a lime wheel.

s.note: Fried rolls of pork mince, wombok, carrot and rice vermicelli
s.how: Soak 50g rice vermicelli and chop. Mix with 300g pork mince, shredded wombok and grated carrot. Roll tightly in spring roll pastry and fry at 180C until crisp and blistered. Serve hot with sweet chilli sauce for dipping.

s.note: Bite size chicken thigh coated in panko and paprika, shallow fried
s.how: Cut 600g chicken thigh into bite-size pieces. Dip in 2 beaten eggs, then in 1 cup flour mixed with 1 cup panko, 1 tsp paprika and salt. Shallow fry in batches for 4 minutes until golden, drain and serve with honey mustard.

m.note: Crispy chicken thigh tossed in a honey and soy glaze, with sesame
m.how: Toss 800g chicken thigh pieces in cornflour and fry until crisp. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp soy sauce until bubbling and toss the chicken through. Scatter with sesame seeds and serve over steamed jasmine rice.

w.note: Thin vanilla cookies folded into the classic fortune shape
w.how: Whisk 2 egg whites with 80g sugar, then mix in 60g flour, 30g melted butter and a drop of vanilla. Spread thin rounds on a lined tray and bake at 180C for 6 minutes. Working quickly while hot, lay a fortune on each, fold and bend over a cup. Be careful what they say.

Mix the cold tea with 120ml lychee syrup and the juice of 1 lime. Fill 4 glasses with ice and 3 lychees each, pour over the tea and top with a splash of soda water and a lime wheel.
